paras: Erythrolamprus ingeri is a species of snake in the subfamily Dipsadinae of the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to Venezuela.
The specific name, ingeri, is in honor of American herpetologist Robert F. Inger.
E. ingeri is found in the Venezuelan state of Bolívar.
The preferred natural habitats of E. ingeri are shrubland and freshwater wetlands, at altitudes of 1,900–2,100 m (6,200–6,900 ft).
